docs.title: MirrorLab
docs.text:
MirrorLab is a two-storey free-for-all test map demonstrating the mirrors and reflection effects included in MirrorKit. The playable map name is FFA_MirrorLab.

Version 1.0.0. Built with ArgonSDK (Unreal Engine 4.25). Requires MirrorKit 1.0.0 or later.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
MirrorLab requires both:

  • MirrorLab.pak
  • MirrorKit.pak

Follow the installation guidance supplied with MirrorKit, then place MirrorLab.pak in your Chivalry 2 TBL/Content/Paks/ folder as well. Launch the game through the Unchained Launcher.

Without MirrorKit.pak, the map structure still loads, but its mirrors, breakable mirror tiles and other MirrorKit effects are missing.

docs.title: Rooms
docs.text:
MirrorLab has an octagonal hub with test rooms on two floors. The stairwell is at 12 o'clock; room letters run clockwise from the stairs, ground floor first (A-G), then the upper floor (H-M). Each doorway has its letter above it.

Room Floor Effect A ground Headless reflection: you have no head in first person. B ground Floor and ceiling mirror pair forming a hall-of-mirrors tunnel. C ground Reference wall-mirror pair with recursive reflections and a walk-through space behind the mirrors. D ground Low-cost shiny floor and ceiling materials using screen-space reflections and baked environment fill; includes the dark-centre variant. E ground Magnified, gappy funhouse mirrors; one is backed by a second funhouse mirror facing the back corridor. F ground Two partnered mirrors, one deliberately turned 20 degrees. G ground Partnered mirror pair with the stretching-head effect. H upper Independent (unpartnered) mirrors: a facing pair and an end-wall mirror showing each other's images, as used in mirror-heavy maps. I upper A wall of breakable live-reflection tiles showing a mirror on each side; broken tiles leave walk-through openings. J upper Ghost reflection: the body disappears while held weapons remain visible. K upper Two live mirrors back to back versus a one-sided mirror, and full-body reflection stand-ins. L upper A triangle of three independent mirrors reflecting each other. M upper Cheap breakable baked mirror tiles. The two halves demonstrate snow-wind and no-snow variants.

Everyone spawns in the centre of the ground-floor hub, facing the stairs; there is no warm-up wait, and respawn waves start once the match is running. The opening in the upper hub floor drops back to the spawn area.

docs.title: Mirror quality
docs.text: MirrorLab uses MirrorKit's default mirror settings. Players can change mirror quality with MirrorKit's launch options (for example -MirrorQuality=Low or -MirrorQuality=Ultra); hosts can set server values or an optional cap in the map options. See Mirror quality in the MirrorKit README.
